mcp.heading: Nanachi MCP
mcp.description: Choose which agents on {{machine}} receive tools to send files and screenshots, request a file, ask questions with option buttons and create app previews in chat. None are enabled by default.
mcp.scope: Only for sessions managed by Nanachi, not a global MCP installation. Changes apply the next time you open or resume a session. Active sessions keep their current tools until stopped.
mcp.empty: No ACP agents are configured on this PC.
mcp.loadFailed: Could not load Nanachi MCP preferences on this PC.
mcp.saveFailed: Could not confirm this change. Your last confirmed selection is still shown.

whisper.title: Local Whisper installation
whisper.unreachable: Could not check Whisper on this PC.
whisper.requestFailed: Could not change Whisper on this PC.
whisper.confirmTitle: Turn off and remove Whisper from this PC?
whisper.confirmDescription: The executable and local model will be deleted. Local transcription will stop; remote providers are unaffected.

transcription.title: Voice dictation
transcription.description: Choose how this PC transcribes microphone recordings. Text is appended to your draft, never sent automatically. Record up to 60 seconds in the app's language.
transcription.chooseModel: Choose a model or enter its ID
transcription.urlHint: For example: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 on this PC. Remote URLs must use HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost or a literal loopback address. Do not include credentials, a query or a fragment.
transcription.keyConfigured: A key is saved on this PC. Leave blank to keep it. Keys are never returned or stored in browser storage.
transcription.keyEmpty: Enter a key for OpenAI or Groq. A key is optional for your own API. Keys are saved only on this PC.
transcription.manualHint: Save the connection first to discover models, or enter an exact compatible speech-to-text model ID manually. Choose and save a model before dictating; a catalog alone does not verify audio support.
transcription.localPrivacy: The default Whisper Base Q5_1 model transcribes offline on this PC. Install it below if needed. No cloud fallback.
transcription.remotePrivacy: Recordings are sent from this PC to the selected API. Cloud providers receive your audio and may charge per use. Native Whisper installation is not required; there is no automatic provider fallback.
transcription.customHint: Your service must implement OpenAI-compatible POST /audio/transcriptions under this base URL (multipart WAV, model and language; JSON text response). Parakeet, Qwen ASR or faster-whisper need a compatible server. Ordinary LLM or Ollama chat endpoints cannot transcribe audio.
transcription.readinessHint: Saved configuration does not verify the API key, model availability or account balance.
transcription.saveBeforeModels: Save this connection before discovering its models.
transcription.noModels: No models were listed. For your own API, enter a compatible model ID manually.
transcription.modelsFailed: Could not discover models. Try Discover models again, or enter your own API's model ID manually.
transcription.loadFailed: Could not load voice dictation settings on this PC.
transcription.saved: Voice settings saved on this PC.
transcription.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Dictation still uses the last saved settings.
transcription.saveFailed: Could not confirm the save. Check the URL, model ID, key and timeout, then try saving again.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are not available in this browser. On a mobile device, open the app from its Home Screen icon (iOS 16.4+).
notifications.enabled: On for this phone: alerts when the agent finishes, asks for approval, fails or sends a file.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the device settings for this app.
notifications.browserFailed: Could not turn on notifications in this browser. Try again.
notifications.noSubscription: The browser did not return the subscription. Try again.
notifications.machineRejected: {{name}}: did not accept the subscription. Try turning it on again.
notifications.machineOtherKey: {{name}}: uses a different notification key, so it does not send alerts to this phone. Copy vapid.json from the main PC (see the README) and turn it on again.
notifications.machineUnreachable: {{name}}: did not respond just now. Turn it on again when it is online.
